_meta.description: Source registry. Every claim in the dataset references a source id here. 'official' = published by the regulator, legislature, government, or the regulated institution itself. 'verified_on' = date this session fetched and read the source.
_meta.verification_policy: A value is only populated if it was read in an official source listed here. Otherwise the field is null and the row is flagged.

sources.title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (Detailed Rules for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange), SAFE Circular Huifa [2007] No. 1
sources.notes: Page is marked 已修改 (as amended). Art. 39 was repealed by Huifa [2023] No. 8; the repeal note is printed at the foot of this official page. Art. 9(2) was amended by Huifa [2016] No. 13.
sources.key_articles: Art. 2 (annual total), Art. 10-12 (above-quota documentation), Art. 13 (non-domestic individuals), Art. 14-15 (outward remittance), Art. 16-23 (capital account), Art. 30-31 (banknotes)

sources.title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration), State Council Order No. 532
sources.publisher: State Council of the PRC / published on SAFE portal
sources.notes: Chapter 7 sets all administrative penalties. Art. 52(2) defines 境内个人 (domestic individual).

sources.title: 国家外汇管理局关于进一步完善个人外汇管理有关问题的通知 (Notice on Further Improving Individual Foreign Exchange Administration), Huifa [2015] No. 49
sources.notes: Establishes the 'watch list' (关注名单) for quota splitting. Effective 2016-01-01. Item 2(3): watch-list period is the year of listing plus the following 2 consecutive years.

sources.title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (Interim Measures for Carrying Foreign Currency Banknotes In and Out of the Country), Huifa [2003] No. 102
sources.publisher: SAFE + General Administration of Customs (SAFE Tianjin branch reproduction of the national circular)
sources.notes: Item 2 of the covering notice states the USD 5,000 / USD 10,000 carrying-permit tiers and that in principle no more than USD 10,000 in banknotes may be carried out.
sources.key_articles: Covering notice item 2; attached Measures Art. 3-5

sources.title: 出境可以带多少现金？ (How much cash may be taken out of the country?) — official Customs reply
sources.publisher: General Administration of Customs of the PRC (Jiangmen Customs)
sources.notes: Confirms RMB 20,000 per person per trip and foreign currency USD 5,000, excluding same-day and short-period multiple crossings. This is a Customs Q&A reply, not the underlying PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 18 itself (see flag F09).

sources.title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知 (Notice on Further Preventing and Disposing of Risks in Virtual Currency Trading Speculation), Yinfa [2021] No. 237
sources.publisher: People's Bank of China and nine other authorities
sources.notes: Dated 2021-09-15, published 2021-09-24. Item 1(2): fiat-to-virtual-currency exchange business is an illegal financial activity, strictly prohibited. Item 1(3): overseas exchanges serving mainland residents over the internet are likewise illegal. Item 4(9): banks and payment institutions may not provide accounts or settlement for such activity.

sources.title: 关于进一步优化跨境人民币政策支持稳外贸稳外资的通知 (Notice on Further Optimising Cross-border RMB Policy), Yinfa [2020] No. 330
sources.publisher: PBOC, NDRC, MOFCOM, SASAC, CBIRC, SAFE
sources.notes: Item 13 supports banks handling individuals' current-account cross-border RMB settlement, expressly including salary and other lawful income. Effective 2021-02-04. Item 15 concerns inbound RMB to NRA accounts and is not an outbound individual route.

sources.title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 (Interim Measures for the Administration of the Sale and Payment of Foreign Exchange for Outbound Transfer of Individual Property), PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16
sources.publisher: People's Bank of China (reproduced with SAFE press release)
sources.notes: Two channels only: emigration transfer and inheritance transfer. Art. 6 staged remittance (half, then half of remainder after 1 year, then all remainder after 2 years); lump sum allowed if total <= RMB 200,000. Art. 10 approval split at RMB 500,000. Art. 11 funds must be wired to the applicant's own account in the country of residence; no banknote withdrawal in China. Effective 2004-12-01.

sources.title: 资本项目外汇业务指引（2024年版） (Capital Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines, 2024 edition), Huifa [2024] No. 12
sources.publisher: SAFE (State Council policy repository reproduction of the SAFE notice)
sources.notes: Issued 2024-04-03. Section 6.4 governs approval of outbound property transfer. Confirmed still applied by SAFE branch Q&A published 2026 (S10).

sources.title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（七） (Q&A on FX purchase and payment for outbound individual property transfer, No. 7)
sources.notes: Published 2026-03-19. Confirms Huifa [2024] No. 12 s.6.4 is the operative rule: emigration transfer approved by SAFE at the emigrant's former household-registration locality; inheritance transfer at the decedent's former locality; heirs of several decedents may consolidate at one locality.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC), as amended 2018-08-31
sources.notes: Art. 1 residence (183 days). Art. 3 rates: comprehensive income 3%-45%; business income 5%-35%; interest, dividends, property lease, property transfer and incidental income 20%. Art. 10(5) and Art. 13 require tax clearance before cancelling Chinese household registration on emigration.

sources.title: 中国银行服务价目表 — 第三章 个人客户服务收费业务 / 一、个人金融 (Bank of China Service Price List, ch.3 personal finance), effective 2025-11-11
sources.publisher: Bank of China (the regulated institution's own published tariff)
sources.notes: Item 210105008: cross-border remittance by TT/draft 0.1% (1‰) of amount, min RMB 50, max RMB 260 per transaction; plus cable charge RMB 80 (HK/Macao/Taiwan) or RMB 150 (international). Note 5: guaranteed-full-value USD service USD 15 if beneficiary bank holds an account at BOC New York, otherwise USD 25. Item 210107011: no FX exchange fee at BOC branches. Item 210101002: FX carrying permit free 2025-04-01 to 2026-12-31. Item 210108014: cross-border ATM withdrawal RMB 12 + 1% of amount, max RMB 112. Item 210106010: clean collection 0.1%, min RMB 50, max RMB 250.

sources.title: 中国银行服务价目 (Bank of China service price list index)
sources.notes: Landing page linking the current tariff PDFs. States the list takes effect 2025-11-11 and links a further adjustment to personal service charges effective 2026-11-11 (see flag F10).

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table (FinCEN civil monetary penalties)
sources.publisher: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (US Treasury / FinCEN)
sources.notes: Table 1, column headed 'penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025': 31 USC 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) non-willful = $16,536 (statutory $10,000); 31 USC 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) willful = $165,353 (statutory $100,000). eCFR displays Title 31 current to 2026-11-05 and shows no amendment to this section after 2025-01-17.

sources.title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
sources.notes: A US person with a financial interest in or signature authority over foreign financial accounts must file an FBAR if the aggregate value exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year. Individual filers may e-file through the BSA E-Filing System without registering.

sources.title: Summary of FATCA reporting for U.S. taxpayers
sources.notes: Full Form 8938 threshold matrix (US resident single $50,000 year-end / $75,000 any time; MFJ $100,000/$150,000; MFS $50,000/$75,000; abroad single $200,000/$300,000; abroad MFJ $400,000/$600,000). Penalties: $10,000 failure to file, up to $50,000 additional for continued failure after IRS notification, 40% penalty on understatement attributable to non-disclosed assets. FBAR due 15 April; Form 8938 due with the return. Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service year-end rate used for conversion.
sources.key_articles: Reporting thresholds; Non-compliance; Form 8938 does not relieve FBAR

sources.title: Instructions for Form 3520 (Rev. December 2025)
sources.notes: Who Must File item 4(a): more than $100,000 from a nonresident alien individual or foreign estate, aggregating related persons. Item 4(b): foreign corporations/partnerships use the section 6039F threshold. Penalties: s.6677 initial penalty greater of $10,000 or 35% of gross value (transfers/distributions), 5% for grantor-trust reporting failure; s.6039F 5% of the gift per month, capped at 25%. Continuous-use revision for tax year 2025 and later.
sources.key_articles: Who Must File 4(a)-(b); Penalties (s.6677, s.6039F, s.6662(j))

sources.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 — 2026 inflation-adjusted items
sources.notes: Section 4.39: foreign earned income exclusion for taxable years beginning in 2026 = $132,900. Section 4.47: section 6039F foreign-gift reporting threshold for taxable years beginning in 2026 = $20,573.

sources.title: 26 U.S.C. 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
sources.publisher: US Government Publishing Office (United States Code, 2023 edition)
sources.notes: s.988(a)(1)(A) foreign currency gain or loss is ordinary. s.988(c)(1)(C) disposition of nonfunctional currency is a section 988 transaction; (ii) includes foreign-currency denominated demand or time deposits issued by a bank. s.988(e)(2) personal-transaction gain exclusion does not apply if the gain exceeds $200. s.988(a)(3)(B)(i) residence = country of tax home.

sources.title: China — Tax treaty documents
sources.notes: Index confirms the US-China income tax treaty and technical explanation are both dated 1984, with PDFs at irs.gov/pub/irs-trty/china.pdf and chintech.pdf. Specific treaty article rates were not read in this session (see flag F07).

sources.title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
sources.notes: Last modified 2025-11-24. Amounts exceeding $10,000 must be reported when entering or leaving the US, on FinCEN Form 105. Threshold applies to families/groups collectively, not per individual. Failure risks forfeiture and civil or criminal penalties. Electronic filing at fincen105.cbp.dhs.gov.
sources.key_articles: Federal Mandate; Who Must File; What if I don't file

sources.title: Foreign earned income exclusion
sources.notes: Confirms US citizens and resident aliens living abroad are taxed on worldwide income; qualification via bona fide residence or 330-full-day physical presence test; exclusion applies to earned income only, not pensions or annuities. The dollar figures printed on this page stop at 2023, so the 2026 amount is taken from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (S18) instead.
sources.key_articles: Qualification rules; Not foreign earned income

sources.title: 现行有效外汇管理主要法规目录（截至2026年6月30日） (Catalogue of principal foreign exchange regulations currently in force, as at 30 June 2026)
sources.notes: Confirms that as at 2026-06-30 the FX Administration Regulations (Order 532), the Individual FX Measures (PBOC Order 2006 No. 3), Huifa [2007] No. 1 and Huifa [2003] No. 102 all remain in force. Used as a currency check on the rules cited on this site.

sources.title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements (IRM 5.21.6 exhibit)
sources.publisher: Internal Revenue Service — Internal Revenue Manual
sources.notes: Useful side-by-side of the two regimes, but the exhibit is stale: it still shows a 30 June FBAR deadline with no extensions and un-indexed $10,000/$100,000 penalties. The current deadline and indexed penalties come from S15/S16 and S14 respectively. Logged as irregularity I-05.

sources.title: 关于调整部分个人服务收费内容的公告（2026年11月11日起） (Announcement adjusting certain personal service charges, effective 11 November 2026)
sources.notes: Published 2026-08-11. Changes ONLY item 210108014 (ATM cash withdrawal). From 2026-11-11: overseas and HK/Macao/Taiwan withdrawals split by network — UnionPay stays RMB 12 + 1% capped at RMB 112 per transaction; Mastercard and VISA become 2.5% of the withdrawal, minimum USD 3 equivalent, maximum USD 40 equivalent per transaction. The old Great Wall International Debit Card 0.5% (min USD 3, max USD 5) line is replaced. No other personal tariff item is changed by this announcement.
